market_question: Will Liverpool finish in the top 4 of the EPL 2025–26 standings?
reasoning: Liverpool have finished top 4 in six of the last seven EPL seasons, possess a deep and experienced squad, and are managed by a stable coaching setup. The market-implied probability of 52.5% significantly undervalues their historical consistency and the relatively weaker depth of rivals like Chelsea, Manchester United, and Tottenham. While transfers and injuries could cause variance, a 72% true probability is well-supported by recent evidence.
evidence_points: Finished top 4 in 6 of the last 7 seasons (exception: 5th in 2022-23)
Core players (Salah, Van Dijk, Alisson) remain world-class; squad depth is superior to all but Man City and Arsenal
Rivals for top 4 places (Chelsea, United, Newcastle, Spurs) have shown greater inconsistency and squad issues
sources_consulted: Comparative analysis of top-4 contenders’ recent performance trends
